title: poa minima
intro: Poa minima, commonly known as the "Least Brome," is a species of grass native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health, likely due to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Poa minima include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the potential benefits of this plant, but it has shown promise in traditional medicine for its ability to treat various health issues.
